proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 2,500 free search queries upon signup, non-expiring.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides clean, structured JSON of Google Search, Google Shopping, and Google Images results. Highly optimized, extremely fast, and does not get blocked by CAPTCHAs, unlike raw scraping from GitHub Actions.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrate into 'agent_trendhunter' or 'agent_niche_gap' to programmatically scrape trending keywords, search volumes, and competitor listings on search engines.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Limited to 2,500 queries initially; requires creating new API keys or a low-cost top-up ($1 per 1,000 queries) if scaled heavily.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100 free API credits daily (refreshed every 24 hours).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides fast serverless API access to SDXL, SD 1.5, ControlNet, and specialized fine-tunes (like line-art or coloring book styles) without cold starts. Extremely reliable compared to Hugging Face free spaces.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrate into 'produce_coloring_book' or 'produce_svg_pack' as a primary or fallback image generation API instead of Pollinations.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Some models cost more credits per run; requires monitoring usage to avoid running out mid-workflow.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to list unlimited 3D models; offers a subscription-based membership model for creators with low commission fees.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: The fastest-growing 3D model search engine and community. It indexes models across the web but also allows direct sales and memberships, serving as a powerful alternative/adjunct to Cults3D for parametric STLs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrate into 'produce_stl_parametric' pipeline to auto-generate description templates and upload metadata optimized for Thangs' search engine.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires manual upload or custom Selenium scripts since they do not offer an open public upload API yet.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Generous sign-up trial credits (typically $10-$20 free), with FLUX.1 Schnell priced at extremely low rates ($0.003 per image).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Offers high-performance, low-latency API access to open-source models including FLUX.1 (Schnell & Dev) and Llama 3.1. It runs on specialized European infrastructure, bypassing GitHub Actions IP bans.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrate into the image generation module as the high-quality FLUX-schnell provider for coloring books and KDP covers.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Strictly API-driven; trial credits expire after a set period, requiring a small credit card deposit to continue (though costs remain under $1/month for Hugo's volume).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free forever plan with access to all features, charging a flat 5% transaction fee on successful sales.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Allows selling digital downloads (PDF coloring books, game assets, SVG packs) directly to consumers. Handles EU/UK VAT calculation and reporting automatically, which is a massive legal hurdle for solo entrepreneurs in France.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Acts as the direct-to-consumer storefront. GitHub Actions can compile products (e.g., zipped assets or PDFs) and Hugo can upload them to Payhip to sell via social media or Pinterest.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires driving your own traffic (no built-in marketplace search volume like Etsy or Redbubble).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free formatting, conversion, and distribution. They take a 10% cut of the retail price only when a sale is made.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Distributes paperbacks and ebooks to multiple major storefronts (Barnes & Noble, Apple Books, Kobo, Tolino) simultaneously from a single manuscript file.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrate into KDP pipelines ('produce_lowcontent_kdp' or 'produce_chess_book') to expand distribution of coloring books beyond Amazon without manual multi-platform re-uploading.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Distribution to physical stores requires strict adherence to formatting guidelines; metadata changes can take several days to propagate across partners.
